name: Soba
siboNotes: Pure buckwheat soba is well-tolerated for SIBO as buckwheat is naturally FODMAP-free. Check labels to ensure no wheat flour is added.
preparationTips: Choose 100% buckwheat soba noodles (juwari soba) to avoid wheat contamination
Rinse cooked soba noodles in cold water to remove excess starch and improve texture
Check ingredient labels as some soba contains wheat flour which adds fructans
Cook until just tender to maintain firm texture and better digestibility
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Good source of fiber and B vitamins
